name: Lisboa (Humberto Delgado) Airport

curfew.v: no landings or take-offs between 00:00 and 06:00 UTC (23:00–05:00 UTC in summer), i.e. midnight to 06:00 local, except force majeure; this applies only to civil subsonic jets of 34,000 kg maximum take-off mass or more, or with more than 19 passenger seats; a limited number of night movements is allowed by government deliberation
curfew.quote: This restriction is only applicable to civil subsonic jet aeroplanes

slots.v: night flights under the exception regime must be coordinated at least one day in advance with the IATA airport slot coordinator
slots.quote: have had a flight coordinated with at least one day in advance with the IATA Airport Slot Coordinator, and

noise.v: night flights under the exception regime need an ICAO Annex 16, Vol I, Chapter 3 noise certificate
noise.quote: have a noise certificate according with ICAO Annex 16, Vol I, Chapt 3.

runway.v: one runway, 02/20, 3,707 m long and 45 m wide

ppr.v: airport slots for non-based carriers allow at most 2 hours of parking; longer parking needs prior approval from Lisboa Airport Management
ppr.quote: Parking periods exceeding this interval, only upon prior approval from Lisboa Airport Management.

handling.v: a slot request must name the ground handling agent at LPPT and give full contact details of a local representative in Lisbon
handling.quote: Ground handling agent at LPPT, name and full contact of local representative in Lisbon

notes: The LPPT AD 2 PDF on ais.nav.pt is blocked to WebFetch (robots), and the AD 2 HTML page could not be opened (permission not given in time). Only the national night rule in AD 1.1.6 was read. Exception-regime airports named there: 'Lisboa (LPPT), Porto (LPPR), Madeira (LPMA), Porto Santo (LPPS) and Ponta Delgada (LPPD)'. Times: the AIP gives UTC with summer UTC in brackets; both equal 00:00–06:00 local. AD 1.1.6 gives no number for the night movements allowed. Re-researched 2026-10-29: AD 2 LPPT (valid from 01 Oct 2026) narrows the national night rule already on file: the 00:00-06:00 local ban applies only to civil subsonic jets with MTOM of 34,000 kg or more or more than 19 passenger seats (crew-only seats excluded). Lighter business jets with 19 seats or fewer are therefore outside the ban, but they still need a slot at this fully coordinated airport. The curfew fact replaces the AD 1.1 one. The AIP times are UTC with summer UTC in brackets; both equal 00:00-06:00 local all year. The AIP shows no IATA code (only ICAO, AFS and SITA addresses) and no general aviation terminal. Based aircraft may park up to 18 hours; longer needs the Airport Director's approval. Taxilane wingspan limits exist (e.g. 48 m on taxilanes A1-A3, M1, K, Y) but no single largest-aircraft rule for business aviation was found. ANA's aeroportolisboa.pt business page as read had no business-aviation or Lisbon handling content.
